name: House of the Knight — Bold Colour-World System (supersedes 'Bright editorial luxury')
reference: buckssauce.com energy: giant type, floating product cutouts, full-screen colour per product, kinetic scroll text, pill UI

colour.accent: hsl(24 96% 48%) hot orange (--gold var name kept)
colour.rule: Each perfume owns a full-screen world; UI inside a world uses --w-bg/--w-ink via worldVars()

components.buttons: pill (rounded-full), uppercase 0.14em tracking, bold; .btn-royal ink→orange hover; .btn-world inherits world ink
components.cards: rounded-[2rem]+, solid colour or cream, large shadows
components.imagery: transparent cutouts /images/cut-*.png via <Bottle/>, .bottle-shadow drop shadows, float + mouse parallax; staged JPGs only as fallback
components.motion: framer-motion EASE [0.16,1,0.3,1]; MaskLines/SplitChars entrances; ScrollWords scroll-scrubbed; sticky stacking chapters; lenis smooth scroll

do_not: go back to cream editorial whitespace with small cards
